title: Question 6.1b: Accuracy Calculation - evaluate() Method
instruction: After making predictions, we need to check how good they are. This code calculates a measure of correctness.
reveal: This code uses the evaluator to calculate accuracy. `.setMetricName("accuracy")` tells it which metric to calculate, and `.evaluate(predictions)` does the actual calculation by comparing predictions to actual labels. Accuracy is the percentage of predictions that were correct. For example, if the model correctly predicted 8,000 out of 10,000 reviews, the accuracy would be 80%.
